reviews.text: Went there to grab a quick coffee and I tried the Cherry Ice coffee. It was amazing ! They offers a wide nice coffee, latte and things like that. Food also looked excellent. The setting is funny, you are surrounded by biking gears and staff was super friendly. They also offer biking gear and organise bike trip on Wednesday ! You should come and see

We stopped by for coffee and snacks. This is a comfortable spot that’s inviting for cyclists or just enthusiasts.   You can safely hang your bicycle in a designated spot and enjoy some seating out in front or inside.   The employees have a great attitude, welcoming and strive to help.
We ended up purchasing 2 pairs of QUOC gravel/ MTB shoes, and 2 pairs of socks.  They ordered our shoes, therefore we needed to comeback to try them on.  Unfortunately, the model shoes we ordered was no longer in stock, and we ended up upgrading to the next level shoes that was available.    My wife tried her shoes on and it fitted well,  my pair of shoes didn’t fit, and we needed to order another size.  When it arrived, it was a good fit as well.  The owner was super friendly and made a great effort in making sure our shoes fit.   He was sorry that our original model ordered was not in stock and truly made sure we were happy with our new order.
We were very pleased with this place and its employees, we plan to return whenever we are back in Taiwan.
Really tasty brunch with nice atmosphere. The cafe is located inside a bike shop which is unique in itself but works quite well. The owner was very lovely.
A cool and hip cafe of great hospitality that is well worth my near 80km ride (2-way) for a visit.
Great place to stop for a coffee and snack right off the river path. Nice selection of bikes and gear as well. The owner Hans is the man!

reviews.text: Excellent.

⭐️Youyou diet reference:
Sweet: 30% hand-cranked sugar

But at this price point and taste, you really can’t be picky. Once you try it, you’ll become a regular customer and you’ll definitely come back to eat here next time.

But the internal environment is not good
Went there in January when it was cold

Selling for 20 yuan each

reviews.text:
Okinawa noodles (plus noodles) $140
You can choose between bonito or soy sauce soup base, this time I chose the latter.
The noodles are flat and have a unique taste.
The red ginger is very sweet, the pork belly is soft and delicious, and the chili wine used for seasoning is also very good.

The store is small and simple, with only two small tables inside, but the boss's own laptops and supplies occupy part of it. In addition to the bad appearance, it can also be seen that the business is not good. The interior has the simple decoration of an ordinary bento shop. The space is small and greasy, and there is no Japanese style expected from an "Okinawa noodle shop". Moreover, it seems to be run by one person. When I entered the store at 5:30 in the evening, there was no one there. call. The overall feeling was really weird. I left without eating and had no intention of coming back.

The boss is very nice and the chili wine is very cool. He also cooks rice. There is a lot of meat and it is delicious. The noodles have a unique texture. The eggs are whole and there are three pieces of flower (fish plate).
The bonito has a light taste, while the soy sauce is salty but not too salty.
There is also a charging socket on the table, which is very considerate.
I had a good shopping experience after trying it in, thank you boss.

The last time I had Okinawa noodles was 10 years ago. Adding chili wine awakened the dusty memory🥹🥹
Special praise for the free upgrade for National Cheng Kung University students~

reviews.text:
This cafe is a bit ‘hidden’ which you may not noticed when you passed by . But the atmosphere is very aesthetic and clam , make ppl want to stay longer in there . The coffee and the dessert are quite okay
The ice cream was nice
But may think about it if want to come for the second time

Nice cafe :) My go-to place for working and studying near NCCU. It has a great atmosphere. They also have an outdoor area where you can sit on a nice weather day. The price of the drinks is reasonable. Apart from coffee, you can also order craft beer here. The cafe also has a cute little cat, so be careful when you open the door.

Ps. If you come here to work, not every seat has a charging stations, and the wooden seats might not make you want to sit for a few hours.

This coffee house is exactly like its name, situated in the middle of nowhere, literally a hole in the wall place. But its low profile and easy going feel makes it uniquely blend in to the neighborhood. Their coffee is really good, few bakery items are also perfect done with nice presentation. I am very happy that I spent my Sunday afternoon here with coffee, cake and finishing up with an IPA.

Delicious dessert with a homey feel,  the coffee drinks here are legit,  staffs are friendly as well. We were sitting at the backyard with breeze, one of the most relaxing cafes in town and I absolutely love the layout and the interior. No reservation, better not come with big groups either.

A lovely café to spend a whole afternoon at. Its location is a bit far from downtown Taipei. I had to take the metro and then transfer to the bus to get there, however, I think it’s worth a visit. The café itself is an old house and pretty small, and it’s designed as a loft, which means the ceiling is low on one side (I’m 5’9 feet and couldn’t stand straight at all), yet it’s well-decorated in the industrial vintage style. I visited on a sunny day and the natural lights shining in were just amazing.

As for food, if I didn't remember wrong, most menu options they have are either drinks or desserts. The only menu option they serve other than cakes is hamburgers (I didn’t order it so I don’t know if it’s good or not). I had a banana & peach cake with a glass of honey lemonade. The cake itself is a bit dry but it tastes pretty good with the cream on top. The staff is very kind and friendly. They say that 2019 is their 7th anniversary and gave me a postcard saying that I could write and leave it in their mailbox, and they will send for me. How sweet! Oh, and they don’t have time limitation which is great. I spent a wonderful afternoon there.

Thanks Mr. Light!

Great foods but the service is okay

The last time I ate it was about ten years ago. I haven’t eaten it in a long time.
I only visited again this time for a family gathering~
📍Price
Compared with nearby restaurants, the price is indeed not cheap, and the portion is not large. But, of course there is a but!
📍Meals
There are many Sichuan dishes on the menu, perhaps taking into account Taiwanese tastes, so they don't taste too spicy.
I personally like the dishes here very much. They are carefully crafted and have a very delicate taste and texture. Perhaps this is the case, so the serving speed is relatively slow.
Among them, I particularly like the three shredded coriander, braised pork ribs and pickled yellow croaker. The three shreds of coriander are a bit sour, and the internal organs are well prepared, making it perfect as an appetizer! The braised pork ribs impressed me very much, the meat was soft and tender, and the sauce was very suitable and tasty. The essence of pickled yellow croaker is in the soup. There is less fish meat (a pity?), but the soup is really delicious!
My younger brother and the elders here also had several bowls of rice~
Like 👍👍

At least 20 years ago, I ate there once. Since the restaurant is located in an alley in Wenshan District, it can be regarded as a community restaurant. I drove by it a few days ago and saw the old signboard from decades ago, which made me feel very friendly. "Eat the old restaurant again", or "traditional flavor".
I ordered braised pork chop and fish-flavored baked egg. The pork chop was quite large, like a hoof, but the texture of the meat was obviously defrosted and reheated, and the lean meat was a bit "woody". The fish-flavored part of the fish-flavored baked eggs has a flavor, but the eggs are not baked and are instead presented in an egg pancake style. You can wrap the fish-flavored eggs with egg slices and eat them, which also has a unique flavor!

I came to a Sichuan restaurant but my family doesn’t eat spicy food.
The boss didn’t mind us and even recommended the hidden version of the menu - fried chicken with soy sauce.
Sweet and crispy cassava paired with caramelized tender chicken ~ It’s really special
The curry beef stew is a little spicy, the beef is super tender, and it’s an eye-catching surprise when paired with coriander! Highly recommended!
But it was my first time to eat fried clams, and I don’t know why it turned out to be large intestine... The taste didn’t quite match.
Everything else is perfect
The tableware is porcelain with cute patterns
Affordable restaurant premium experience
